$comment: Machine-readable description of this board, used by preflight.sh and by automated solvers. The prize is deliberately absent: anyone may add to a bounty, so it is mutable and lives on the platform, not in a pinned repository file.
$comment_verification: The checker runs inside a container with no network and a read-only filesystem. You build the image yourself, so the script inside it is the script you can read here.

prerequisites.$comment: Docker must be installed AND its daemon running. The image is small; the disk figure is headroom.

$comment_selfCheck: Run this against your submission before submitting. It is the same checker the reviewer runs.
$comment_tasks: This repository serves the boards listed here. They may pin different criteria commits: what counts as a solution was fixed per board and cannot move.
